Portable SLANG packages contain the IDE, native interpreter, graphics library,
examples, and offline documentation. Extract the complete archive; no separate
Node.js, SDL, or .NET installation is needed. Native-only CLI archives are included.

Choose Windows x64, Linux x64, macOS Intel (x64), or macOS Apple Silicon (arm64).
Linux builds use Ubuntu 22.04 as their build baseline and require a compatible
desktop OS and graphics drivers. See docs/releases.md for platform qualification.

These preview packages have no publisher signature or Apple notarization.
macOS ad-hoc signatures support execution but do not establish publisher trust.

Language and IDE: MIT. Original graphics examples/assets: CC0 1.0 Universal.
Third-party components retain their own licenses. SHA256SUMS.txt covers all archives.
